album: Calling the Deal: M&A for builders
feed_description: A deal lawyer and an investor work through private M&A agreements, one negotiation at a time.
listener: An experienced commercial operator learning to read agreements, weigh competing positions and advise on a deal.

Nadia.role: senior M&A partner, English-qualified, 20 years of Gulf and European private M&A. Precise, dry, quietly funny. Explains mechanism, not trivia. Says where things usually land and what moves them.

Sam.role: Deal partner at a growth investor. Tests the assumptions behind each recommendation and asks what the investor would do at signing or closing.

extra_rules: Use plain commercial language. Teach through public filings and clearly fictional scenarios. Invent a different business problem when replacing private deal material. Keep private negotiations, walkthroughs and identifying facts out of the dialogue.
